extracted_concepts.name: L'Hôpital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule for evaluating limits of indeterminate quotient forms using derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: 0/0 Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator limits are 0.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞/∞ Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator limits are ∞.

extracted_concepts.name: Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Form such as 0/0 or ∞/∞ whose limit is not determined directly.

extracted_concepts.name: 0·∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indeterminate product rewritten as a quotient for L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞-∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indeterminate difference handled by combining fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: 1^∞ Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indeterminate power handled by taking logarithm.

extracted_concepts.name: 0^0 Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indeterminate power handled by taking logarithm.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞^0 Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indeterminate power handled by taking logarithm.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change used in L'Hôpital's Rule and Taylor expansions.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit of Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence condition for applying L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Take logarithm to convert indeterminate powers to quotients.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function used to transform powers before applying L'Hôpital.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor's Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expands a function using derivatives plus a remainder term.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite sum of derivatives at a point representing a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Maclaurin Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taylor series centered at a = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder Term
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Term R_n measuring error of Taylor polynomial approximation.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of a function by a polynomial.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First-order approximation generalized by Taylor series.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first used in Taylor expansions.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms used to represent functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation of finding derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation connected to Taylor series through calculus relationships.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for sin x.

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for 1/(1-x).

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series for ln(1+x).
